messages:
Sara (SRE): Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-06-batch-latency. Need to lock owners for SLO changes and remediation timeline.
Miguel R: Quick summary: P99.9 spikes align with nightly batch window 02:40-03:10 UTC; error budget burn reached 38% this week.
Aisha K: We should add a route-level tail SLO and a 5m sustained throughput SLI. Also recommend tiered paging for enterprise customers.
Sara (SRE): Draft targets: route_p99_9 <= 1.2s at 99.6% (monthly); sustained_throughput 5m >= 90% baseline (baseline=median weekday 02:00-04:00). 14-day shadow validation.
Miguel R: PromQL for p99.9 (5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
And throughput SLI (5m avg):
```
avg_over_time(sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route)[5m:1m])
```
Aisha K: I'll own SLO docs & PM/legal comms (due 2026-06-10).
Miguel R: I'll implement alerts + dashboard panels in staging (due 2026-06-08). Preemptive alert: P99.9 > 1200ms for 3/5 windows; throughput drop >25% for >10m.
slo-bot: Incident INC-2026-0605-01 recorded. Assigned: Miguel R.
Sara (SRE): Infra action: add jitter 0-20m and tenant concurrency caps for heavy batch jobs. Who owns?
Aisha K: I'll coordinate with Batch Infra and run outreach to heavy-tenants (due 2026-06-12).
runbook-bot: Runbook update queued: section "Nightly batch spike (02:40-03:10 UTC)" with mitigations: tenant caps, fallback routing, temporary scale to +25%.
Sara (SRE): Action summary -> Miguel: alerts+dashboards; Aisha: docs+tenant outreach+infra sync; Sara: tracking ticket RED-4712 + SLO proposal review meeting next Wed 11:00. React with :white_check_mark: if accepted.
Miguel R: :white_check_mark: accepting.
Aisha K: :white_check_mark: accepting.
Sara (SRE): Thanks all. Will log owners in the postmortem and set calendar invite.
